items.name: Apple
items.usage_fact: Apples are sweet, crunchy fruits that grow on trees in orchards and are full of healthy vitamins.
items.learning_prompt: What color is this crisp apple? Red! Can you find other red things around you?

items.name: Banana
items.usage_fact: Bananas grow in sunny warm places and give our bodies great energy to run and play.
items.learning_prompt: Bananas are curved like a happy smile! What color is a ripe banana?
items.licensing: Royalty-Free AI Production Asset (Little Wonder World Proprietary)

items.name: Mango
items.usage_fact: The mango is known as the King of Fruits! It is wonderfully sweet, juicy, and delicious.
items.learning_prompt: Smell the sweet golden mango! Have you ever tasted delicious mango juice?
items.licensing: Royalty-Free AI Production Asset (Little Wonder World Proprietary)

items.name: Bus
items.usage_fact: Buses carry many passengers together safely through town, to school, and across cities.
items.learning_prompt: The wheels on the bus go round and round! How many wheels can you see?
items.licensing: Royalty-Free AI Production Asset (Little Wonder World Proprietary)

items.name: Car
items.usage_fact: Cars help families travel together comfortably on roads and highways.
items.learning_prompt: Beep beep! Remember to always buckle your seatbelt before the car moves!

items.name: Watermelon

items.name: Pineapple

items.name: Strawberry
items.usage_fact: Strawberries are heart-shaped red berries with tiny seeds on the outside!

items.name: Guava
items.usage_fact: Guavas are fragrant tropical fruits that are crunchy and full of vitamins.

items.name: Papaya
items.usage_fact: Ripe papayas have soft, sweet orange flesh that is great for tummy health.

items.name: Pomegranate
items.usage_fact: Inside a pomegranate are hundreds of shiny red jewel-like seeds called arils!

items.name: Coconut
items.usage_fact: Coconuts grow high on palm trees and hold refreshing coconut water and white meat inside.

items.name: Carrot
items.usage_fact: Carrots are crunchy orange root vegetables rich in Vitamin A that help our eyes see clearly!

items.name: Potato
items.usage_fact: Potatoes grow underground on roots and give us warm, comforting energy.

items.name: Tomato
items.usage_fact: Tomatoes are smooth, juicy red vegetables used in salads, soups, and sauces!

items.name: Onion
items.usage_fact: Onions have many papery layers inside and add wonderful flavor to meals.

items.name: Brinjal
items.usage_fact: Brinjal (eggplant) has shiny purple skin and a little green cap on top!

items.name: Cabbage
items.usage_fact: Cabbage is a round ball of crisp green leaves wrapped tightly together.

items.name: Cauliflower
items.usage_fact: Cauliflower looks like a fluffy white cloud surrounded by green leaves!

items.name: Pumpkin
items.usage_fact: Pumpkins are big, round, ribbed orange vegetables that grow on trailing vines.

items.name: Cucumber
items.usage_fact: Cucumbers are mostly water inside, making them super cool and crunchy on sunny days!

items.name: Peas
items.usage_fact: Green peas sleep together in a row inside a cozy green pea pod!

items.name: Beetroot
items.usage_fact: Beetroots are deep ruby-red root vegetables that are sweet and full of iron.

items.name: Train
items.usage_fact: Trains roll smoothly on steel railway tracks and carry passengers and goods across long distances!

items.name: Aeroplane
items.usage_fact: Aeroplanes have big wings and jet engines to fly high above the clouds across countries and oceans!

items.name: Helicopter
items.usage_fact: Helicopters have spinning rotor blades on top that let them hover in one spot and take off straight up!

items.name: Bicycle
items.usage_fact: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals that we push with our feet for fun, healthy exercise!

items.name: Motorcycle
items.usage_fact: A motorcycle is a two-wheeled motor vehicle—riders always wear a strong safety helmet!

items.name: Tractor
items.usage_fact: Tractors have huge, deep-treaded back wheels to help farmers plow soil and pull farm trailers.

items.name: Truck
items.usage_fact: Trucks are strong cargo vehicles that carry food, building materials, and supplies to stores.

items.name: Boat
items.usage_fact: Boats float gently on lakes and rivers using oars, sails, or small motors.

items.name: Ship
items.usage_fact: Giant ships sail across deep oceans carrying travelers and containers around the world.

items.name: Ambulance
items.usage_fact: An ambulance has flashing lights and a siren to carry paramedics and help sick people get to the hospital fast.

items.name: Fire Engine
items.usage_fact: A bright red fire engine carries brave firefighters, long ladders, and water hoses to put out fires!

items.name: Ball
items.usage_fact: A round, bouncy play ball is great for kicking, catching, and rolling with friends outdoors!

items.name: Book
items.usage_fact: Books are filled with stories, pictures, and knowledge that take our imagination on wonderful adventures!

items.name: Pencil
items.usage_fact: We hold a pencil to write letters, numbers, and draw creative pictures on paper.

items.name: Chair
items.usage_fact: A sturdy chair has four legs and a backrest so we can sit comfortably while reading or eating.

items.name: Table
items.usage_fact: A table has a flat top where families gather to eat meals, study, and build puzzles.

items.name: Clock
items.usage_fact: A clock has numbers from 1 to 12 and moving hands that tell us the time of day!

items.name: Umbrella
items.usage_fact: An umbrella opens like a canopy overhead to keep us dry in the rain and shaded from hot sun.

items.name: Shoes
items.usage_fact: We wear comfortable shoes on our feet to protect them when walking, running, and playing outside.

items.name: Bag
items.usage_fact: A school backpack bag has shoulder straps to carry our books, pencils, and lunchbox neatly.

items.name: Bottle
items.usage_fact: A reusable water bottle keeps clean drinking water ready so we stay hydrated all day!

items.name: Cup
items.usage_fact: A cup has a curved handle so we can hold it safely to drink warm milk or water.

items.name: Spoon
items.usage_fact: We use a clean spoon to scoop and eat soup, rice, yogurt, and cereal.

items.name: Toothbrush
items.usage_fact: A toothbrush has soft bristles that clean our teeth every morning and night for a bright smile!

items.name: Bed
items.usage_fact: A cozy bed has a soft mattress, pillow, and blanket where we sleep and recharge every night.

items.name: Rainbow
items.usage_fact: A rainbow appears in the sky when sunlight shines through raindrops, showing seven glowing colors!

items.name: Sun
items.usage_fact: The Sun is a bright star at the center of our solar system that gives Earth warm daylight and helps plants grow!

items.name: Moon
items.usage_fact: The Moon shines softly in the night sky and changes shape from a thin crescent to a bright full circle!

items.name: Stars
items.usage_fact: Stars are distant suns twinkling across the night sky in beautiful patterns called constellations.

items.name: Cloud
items.usage_fact: Clouds float in the sky and are made of tiny water droplets that bring refreshing rain to the Earth.

items.name: Tree
items.usage_fact: Trees have deep roots, a sturdy trunk, and green leaves that make fresh oxygen for us to breathe!

items.name: Flower
items.usage_fact: Flowers bloom with colorful petals and sweet fragrance, inviting bees and butterflies to visit.

items.name: Mountain
items.usage_fact: Mountains are giant landforms that rise high into the sky, often crowned with white snow at the peak!

items.name: River
items.usage_fact: A river is a flowing ribbon of fresh water that travels from mountains down through valleys to the sea.

items.name: Waterfall
items.usage_fact: A waterfall happens where a river tumbles over a high rocky cliff into a misty pool below!

items.name: Ocean
items.usage_fact: The ocean is a vast body of salty water that covers most of our planet and is home to whales, dolphins, and coral reefs!
